name: front_corner_box_hand_collision
hypothesis: The earlier smaller central box remained untouched. A larger box at the front corner extends farther into the hand's approach and retreat clearance around the pull bar. The empty-scene collision model permits direct contact during position-controlled motion.
expected_failure: Step 2 contacts and pushes or topples the cereal box; damage may occur even if the door-opening check passes.
